Question: If am working with an organization which takes business from a bank and collect money from the customer for credit cards on behalf of the organization. Will it be ok to do this job as per shariya. Answer ID: 23946 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1125/857=1431) It is allowed to collect money from customers for credit card. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
